segments.text: Hey friends, what is this 7 Days Ultimate Challenge?
Just a while ago, I posted a video
about the 30 Days Challenge, and before that, I had posted a 6 Months Challenge.
So why this 7 Days Challenge now?
Well, let me tell you. But before that, I have a question for you — how many
times has it happened
with you that you start trying to build some good habits in your life...
…but they die before their time — and then you regret it.
It hurts, and you feel bad.
And every time, there’s a voice… a voice you may not hear with your ears, but
it definitely echoes
in your heart, your mind, and deep in your subconscious — **”Loser.”**
Now this voice, and the feeling that comes with it — the feeling of wanting
to do so much more but just not being able to — that is truly dangerous.
This will destroy your confidence.
It will weaken the belief you have in yourself and
will stop you from achieving anything big in life. That’s why
it’s important to fight it. I’m going to give you the ultimate solution
for this — a system that’s guaranteed to break
you out of this loop and bring back that **winner’s mindset** within you.
First six
months, then 30 days, and now 7 days — I haven’t done this randomly.
There’s deep psychology behind it, personal experience, and
a powerful science-backed strategy. I’ll explain everything in this video.
The video is divided into three parts — In Part One, we’ll focus on the **”why”**
— Why you need to take this 7-day challenge, Why so
many times you try to do something, but it just doesn’t work out.
What’s the reason behind this? **Self-efficacy** — something that
the world’s top psychologists say is the **number one factor** that decides whether
you’ll be successful at something or not. We’ll understand how to use
it effectively. Then we’ll move to the **”what”** — how you can create the
**winner’s effect** within yourself using the **WIN framework**, which will
eliminate the negative feelings inside you and **rewire your brain**.
To take consistent action for the long term — And finally, we’ll come
to the **”how.”** Here, I’ll share with you the **START Method**, using which
you’ll be able to convert all of this into habits with momentum, achieve a **flow
state**, and give your **best performance**
in life. And yes, if you stay till the end, there will be a
**special gift** from me — as a reward for your patience and dedication. But
we’ll talk about that later. So if you’re ready, let’s start with the
**WHY** — Have you noticed how we often take on some big challenge in life…
Like a 6-month transformation challenge, or even a 30-day transformation challenge
— In the beginning, your energy is high.
Your motivation is high. But after a few days, everything starts to slow down.
The fire inside you starts to fade… it fizzles out. And many times, a thought
starts creeping into your heart and mind — *“Maybe I can’t do this… it’s too hard…
I don’t think I have the time.”* So, what does psychology
say about this? What does science say? Well, science says exactly this…
The reason behind this is **not your laziness**
— The real problem is your **mindset**. If we define it in two words, it’s called
**self-efficacy**. Do you know? Many researchers around the
world have studied this term and concluded that
it’s the **number one reason** that determines whether you’ll
be a **success or a failure** in life. Let me give you an example.
Researchers from **Stanford** and
other top psychologists conducted a study and found that — For example, if you
take 100 people and ask them to set a goal, like losing weight, starting a
business, or building a daily reading habit — Out of those, only **20 to 30
people** are able to achieve some part of their goal even after facing doubt.
Whereas around **70 to 80 percent of people**…
The people who **believe in themselves**, who think *“Yes, I can do it,”* — they
are the ones who actually achieve their goals. Just think about it: **Low
self-belief** = only **20% success** **High self-belief** =
up to **80% success** So if you simply start believing in yourself — if you
increase the value
of your **self-efficacy**, everything can change. Look, a few weeks ago I
launched that **6-month challenge**, and over **2,500
people** publicly commented and joined that challenge.
More than **80%
of those people** must have dropped off by now — they’re probably not
continuing anymore. Why? Not because they lack talent — but because
they lack **self-efficacy**. That’s exactly what we need to focus
on building. So how do you build it? **Don’t focus
on big wins.** Focus on **small
victories** — Because when you win even a small battle, even
if it’s just a 7-day challenge, and you actually complete it, your brain releases
**dopamine**… You’ll start to **feel like a winner**, but
most people do the **opposite**. I’ve seen it myself — Many times, people
lose **5 kilos**, and yet they still feel bad
about themselves, saying, *“My body still doesn’t look the way I want it to.”*
They completely ignore the fact that they’ve already
lost 5 kilos! And even after achieving that,
they still feel like a **loser** — and because of that…
Then they start losing the motivation to go to the gym. But if we
do the **opposite**, it creates what’s called the **Winner’s Effect**. I
explained this in detail in one of my videos — how even a **weaker mouse**
can defeat a much **stronger mouse** if the **Winner’s Effect**
is activated within it. That’s why you may have noticed — people
who **start winning** in life often begin to succeed **in every area** of life.
On the other hand, those who experience
**failure** — you’ll notice that they often start failing
in **many areas** of life. That’s why it’s so important to start developing
the **Winner’s Effect** within yourself — because it will boost
your **self-efficacy**. And how do we do that?...
To do this, you need to understand the **WIN Framework**. As I
mentioned earlier, the biggest reason we fail to stay consistent
with anything isn’t **laziness** — most of the time, it’s **self-doubt**.
That voice in your head that says, *”Will the actions I’m taking even lead
to anything?”* *”Will
I actually be able to do this or not?”* That **doubt** starts creeping in...
That voice starts to creep in — and **that voice will not let you
move forward**. So what should you do in such moments? You need to **focus
on winning**. For example, let me share my personal story — I had tried going
to the gym many times. I kept thinking, *“I’ll go regularly, I’ll do it…”* But
it just wasn’t working for me. Then what did I do? I started focusing
on **small wins** — I told myself, *“Okay fine, instead of going 6 days a
week, I’ll just go 3 days a week — and do MMA there.”*
Because I find **MMA really interesting** — I enjoy it. So I focused on going
just **three days a week**, and along with that, I also started **swimming**, since
the swimming pool at
my clubhouse is right next to my home. So what happened when I started doing
these **easy things**? Gradually, I
began to **build momentum**. And guess what? Today, I go to the **gym six days
a week** without any trouble — because once **momentum
builds**, even the **big things** start to feel **easy**.
Similarly, the same thing will happen with you — **if you use the WIN
Framework**. So, how do we use the WIN Framework? In **WIN**, **W** stands
for **Wake-Up** — This is the thing I’m talking to you
about right now. You need to **wake up to this realization every single
week**. What most people do is set goals only **once a
year**, or maybe **once every six months**, or **once a month**...
I say, go even smaller — **start with every week**. For example, every
**Sunday is followed by a Monday**, a new week begins, and with it comes a fresh
start — a new energy awakens inside me. In the same way, you can make these
Sunday videos your **trigger**.
Every time you watch the video, it will act as your **wake-up call**. Let
these Sunday videos be a reminder for you that a **new week has begun**.
You’ve got a **new chance to win**. So in this framework, understand this:
Make **every Sunday your trigger**. Instead of focusing
too much on **yearly goals**, focus more on **weekly goals** — and when you start
winning those, your **momentum will build**. Then your 6-month goals…
even your 1-year goals… they’ll start falling into place on their own.
Now let’s move to the **“I” in WIN**, which stands for **Identity Shift**.
Look, many times when we set a **6-month goal**, we feel like — *“6 months
is just too long.”* Even **30 days** can feel overwhelming.
And when you’re **not able to complete even 7
days**, you start giving yourself that **“loser” identity**
— *“If I couldn’t even do it for a month, maybe I’m
not good enough.”* That’s exactly why things stop working out for you.
Remember, **identity
is a very powerful thing**. A person can even give up their life if they carry
the identity of a **soldier**. Similarly, if you have a
**strong identity** — whether it’s based on religion or any deep belief — you
start becoming **a certain type
of person**, and even the toughest tasks become easier for you. The
problem is, most people give themselves the **wrong kind of identity**.
Like when someone
says, *“I tried something but couldn’t do it,”* — they start calling themselves
a **loser**, they label themselves **inconsistent** or **lazy**.
But do you remember the movie **”12th Fail”**? Even in that, the hero keeps
trying and failing — but he **never identifies himself
as a loser**. He understands, *“Okay, I failed the exam — no big deal.”*
No problem — *“I’ll try again in the next exam.”* **Restart.
Restart.** His entire concept of restarting is incredibly powerful
— and you need to apply that in the
**WIN Framework** as well. In your life, **no
matter how many times you try**, even if you’re **not able to complete the 7
days**, **don’t let go of this consistency mindset**.
As I told you — **every week is a new beginning** for
you, **every week is a new chance to win**. Just keep **trying again**.
Once you complete those **7 days**, your **confidence
will start building up**. And then, you might be able to do **21 days**, even
go on to complete **6 months** — but first, you have to **crack those initial 7
days**. That’s the **most important** part.
And finally, in the WIN framework, **N** stands for
**NOW** — **Start Now**. If you’ve already been consistent
for the past 2–3 weeks, that’s great — but if not, **start today itself**.
If you haven’t been consistent, then **start from today**.
**Don’t label yourself a loser.** Understand this — for example,
every time you fail, don’t focus on the failure itself. Look
at what’s really happening — **you’re slowly getting closer to success**.
The only problem is that you keep giving yourself the **wrong
identity** every time the trigger doesn’t work or you slip up.
No worries — **stop overthinking**, stop over-planning
— just **start and repeat**. Take **Milo of Croton** for example — he was
one of the greatest athletes of ancient times. No one could defeat him. He was
incredibly strong and powerful. And how did he achieve that strength?
By doing **one simple thing daily** — He started by lifting a **small calf**
on his shoulders, and every day, he would carry it around on his shoulders.
Here’s what happened — slowly, the **calf kept growing**, and
eventually it became a **big bull**. And **Milo** became incredibly
strong by lifting it every day. This is called **Progressive Overload** — a
concept also used in fitness and gyms. You can apply the **same principle**
in your life too. First, just **focus on the 7 days** — **win that**, and once
you do, you’ll experience a powerful **mindset shift**.
You’ll get a chance to **reset weekly**, a **dopamine boost** from those small
wins, and a build-up of **confidence**
— which will increase your **self-efficacy**.
After that, you need to use the **START system**. In this system, **S** stands
for **Select One Habit** — Just like I told you in the previous video.
You probably have a list of many habits in front of you right now\...
Pick **any one habit** from the list — or even if it’s not on the list, you can
choose a habit outside of it. For example: going for a **morning walk**,
or **not eating sugar**. Whatever resonates with you, pick
**just one thing**. The second step — **T** — stands for **Track for 7
Days**. Whatever habit you choose today, **write it down**, post it
in the **comments**, and start **tracking it daily** — For example...
When we do a **21-day challenge**, we usually **track it visually** — this
is what we do for our **paid community** members. The third step is **Apply**
— You can apply this tracking step in a very **simple way**. If you don’t want
to use pen and paper and create a full chart — that’s okay. (Though if you
do, it’s even better.) But along
with that, you can also simply **post it in the comments below**.
Whatever habit you’re committing to, **write it down** —
clearly mention the habit. Write **Day 1**, and then each following day,
just **reply to your own comment** with **Day 2**, **Day 3**, and so on.
This way, I’ll also be able to **see how many days you’ve
been consistent**, which will make it easier for me to **reward
you**. In the **START system**, **R** stands for **Reward & Report**.
Look,
after you complete the **7 days**, I want you to fill out a **Google Form**
— the link will be given below. But make
sure you **fill it only after completing all 7
days**. I’ll be checking the comments — I’m taking
full **accountability** for this. Those who truly complete the 7
days consistently, you’ll
go to the form below and **submit it**. And remember
— for **every week you complete**, you’ll earn a **STAR**.
🌟 Consider this **star as your badge of honor**. It will trigger the
**Winner’s Effect** in you again. You’ll gain confidence — *“Yes, I can
do this!”* Once you collect **4 to 5 stars**, it means you’ve completed **one
month** — and you’ll be added to the **One-Month Winners List**.
And from there, you’ll move on from the **One-Month Winners** to the **Six-Month
Winners List**.
And this was my **7-day psychology**. Remember what I told you in the
beginning? There’s a **psychological concept** behind this. It’s called
the **”Door in the Face” technique**. It works like this — when you make a **big
request** to someone, for example, *“Can you give me ₹50,000?”*,
the other person will most likely **say no**. But then, when you **ask
for just ₹5,000**, they’re **more likely to agree** and give it to you.
Many people use this trick while asking for a loan. You should be careful. The
truth is — they only needed ₹5,000, but they asked for ₹50,000 so that you’d
become psychologically weak, and then they made their **real
request**. Similarly,
when I said “six months,” understand — I didn’t say it intentionally as a
trick, but something like that happened. I said six months, but maybe six months
didn’t actually happen.
When I said one month, maybe even that one month didn’t actually
happen. But now, the probability of you completing **one week** has increased a
lot — so go ahead and do it. Again, I would like to **openly invite you** to the
**7-day challenge**. Every week,
I will keep coming back as your brother, as your mentor, as your weekly reminder.
The challenge I started — the 6-month one — that is still continuing.
I know that many people are not able to do this challenge.
For those who are struggling or might quit later, all these things will be very
helpful. So keep doing this regularly. If you’re serious, then as I told you
— once you complete the challenge, make sure to fill out the Google Form.
And if you want to stay updated about this challenge and stay seriously connected
with me, then there is a WhatsApp community — make sure to go and join it.
I will announce the winners, and many times I’ll do it live as well.
So when the live happens, how it happens,
and where it happens — I’ll keep uploading those details in the WhatsApp community.
So make sure to join the WhatsApp community. If possible, tag me
on Instagram stories
too. Many of you have already started tagging me — awesome, very, very nice.
So obviously...
Those who are visible to me — their probability of becoming winners
will also start increasing, just like I mentioned in the previous video. If you
haven’t seen it, go watch it. The people who become winners — monthly winners —
there will be some special gifts for them that I’ll keep giving.
But again, you should not be doing this challenge for gifts or money.
You need to do this to bring about change within yourself — because that will
be your biggest reward. Alright? Now lastly, I just want to say this — every
time we start a new habit and quit it halfway, it’s not just the habit
we drop. We register a small defeat. A voice starts echoing in our mind — not
in our ears, but in our heart — saying, “You can’t do it.” “It’s not your cup
of tea.” That’s the voice that holds you back whenever you try to start something
new. But what I want is — that voice which keeps coming back in your mind,
in your heart, in your subconscious — I want that voice to go silent.
And that can happen. Just win once — win over yourself — for seven days.
Just one small win — one that reminds you, “Yes, I *can* do it.” That’s what
creates the *winner effect*. So from today, every
Sunday will be like a New Year for us — a fresh energy, a renewed mindset, and a
new mission to win. A new chance, every week. So keep showing up,
stay subscribed. I’ll be here every week to give you that chance to win.
Stop overthinking.
Just comment and write down what I told you — starting *today*, your habit.
And keep coming back daily to comment and continue with it. Every week, you’ll
earn a star. Every star will be a chance for you to win. That’s it for now.
Let’s begin your transformation journey
from today. See you in the next video with your weekly reminder. Bye-bye!
